articles.title: What Mike Vrabel said about his viral challenge flag toss
articles.description:
Vrabel said he plans on keeping his challenge flag duties, although he is allowed to delegate them to another staffer if he wants.

The post What Mike Vrabel said about his viral challenge flag toss appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Mike Vrabel plans to retain challenge flag duties for the Patriots.
Vrabel can delegate flag responsibilities to staff if desired.
Local fans may see more strategic challenges during upcoming games.
